headline: On October 26, 2004: Rockstar Games releases GTA: San Andreas
captionCards: GTA: San Andreas sold 12 million units on PS2
Rockstar Games became a household name after this
instagramCaption:
Rockstar Games changes the gaming landscape with a new release. \\[On October 26, 2004, Rockstar Games, an American video game publisher, released Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas for the PlayStation 2 in North America. The game sold 12 million units, making it the best-selling PS2 game. Founded in 1998 by Terry Donovan, Gary Foreman, Dan and Sam Houser, and Jamie King, Rockstar Games has since become a household name.\\The game's success solidified Rockstar's position as a leading innovator in the gaming industry.\\What's your favorite memory from playing GTA: San Andreas?\\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
